note: EVIDENCE: Deezer album and track lists (labels, years, timings) are the main recording evidence, with MusicBrainz work lists, IMSLP work-info fields, Wikipedia work lists (Hindemith, Myaskovsky, Webern, Schoenberg, Turina, Bloch, Korngold, Stravinsky, Casella), the Carl Nielsen Edition pages and a few web searches; Naxos Library and Presto were not used and Apple answered only a few queries. Minutes are IMSLP averages or the cited recording's timing. No key is given where sources disagree or omit it (Hindemith Nos. 4-5, Bloch Nos. 2-5, Schoenberg Nos. 3-4). GAP CHECK (20 works IMSLP lacks or filed elsewhere): Webern Rondo and the song cycles Op. 14, 15, 17; Schoenberg Pierrot lunaire, Serenade Op. 24, Ode to Napoleon, Weihnachtsmusik; Stravinsky's clarinet-violin-piano Suite, Pastorale, Pribaoutki, Three Songs from William Shakespeare, In memoriam Dylan Thomas (IMSLP has a page the census missed); Turina Piano Trio in F; Casella Sonata a tre and Serenata Op. 46 (IMSLP page outside the census); Respighi Double Quartet; Zemlinsky Two Movements; Howells Quartet No. 3; Koechlin Quartet No. 2. OWNER MAY RULE: the voice-with-ensemble works (Webern Op. 14/15/17, Schoenberg Pierrot/Serenade/Ode, Stravinsky Pribaoutki/Shakespeare/Dylan Thomas) are in under the vocal rule; Webern's Symphony Op. 21 (nine players, strings usually doubled) and Stravinsky's Three Japanese Lyrics (ten players) are out. Hindemith Op. 47 uses oboe for the heckelphone with tenor saxophone as printed alternative. WEAK SPOTS: Webern Op. 14/17 scorings come from catalogue entries, not a score; Zemlinsky's Maiblumen blühten überall not added (scoring unconfirmed); Schmitt's Andante et Scherzo Op. 35 has one MusicBrainz recording but no release was found; Nielsen's CNW 50 stands for the F-major quartet FS 3k and CNW 51-52 are skipped as its other movements (mapping from the Carl Nielsen Edition note and the BIS track list only); the Koechlin and Schmitt catalogues are large and no full work list was at hand. The four violin-catalogue entries of this slice (Hindemith and Nielsen duets, Prokofiev's two-violin sonata) are duos and not cross-listed; Nielsen's Five Three-part Fugues have unspecified instruments. No benchmark issues.
